_meta.title: College Football Career Awards & Honors
_meta.scope: Only athletes recorded in the six attended college football games; years denote career honors even when earned outside attended match
rules: No watch-list, preseason, weekly or mere nominee tags
Use national award wins, postseason All-America selections, conference individual awards, postseason all-conference (first/second/third) and official all-freshman teams
Do not conflate All-American selection providers: AP, STATS, Walter Camp, AFCA and others retain separate issuer titles
Do not assign a conference title across seasons without verified player participation in the championship team's season
Player career NFL draft/debut/roster tags are loaded separately from the existing verified CFB-to-NFL crosswalk
2026 football season awards not yet announced by November 12 2026 are intentionally omitted
Positive checked matches are not an exhaustive audit of every award in all 286 careers
